_doc: Literature-anchored causal sign priors for counterfactual (Route C) question labels. Only targets present in the 14-lab CLMBR decoder panel are listed, so every arrow is checkable. 'dir' is the sign of the effect of ADDING/INCREASING the intervention on the target lab. These are LABELS derived from pharmacology/guidelines, NOT from the world model. Keyed by action_schema group name.

glucose.cite: ADA Standards of Care; inpatient hyperglycemia management

potassium.mechanism: loop diuretic increases distal K+ secretion / kaliuresis

bun.mechanism: diuresis -> intravascular volume depletion -> prerenal azotemia

potassium.mechanism: dialysate K+ gradient clears serum K+

no_checkable_lab.vasopressin: raises MAP / SVR; not in lab panel
